Container.Name: Strata
Container.Overview:
Strata runs large mixture-of-experts models on an NVIDIA GPU plus system RAM: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next and its variants, the smaller Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash. It serves an OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible API, a chat page and a live monitor. This template runs Strata's official image.
Requirements: the Nvidia Driver plugin on driver 580 or newer and an RTX 20/30/40/50 card. For a GTX 10, P100 or V100, or a driver from 575 to 579, change the Repository tag to latest-cuda12. You also need 32 GB of RAM or more (more RAM allows a larger, better model) and room for the model on an SSD pool.
DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash: set Model family to deepseek41 and Model to ist-das-1.75bpw, ist-das-2.00bpw, ist-das-2.25bpw or ista-das-coder. It needs the latest-cuda13 tag, an RTX 30/40/50 card with 12 GB or more, 46 GB of RAM or more (64 GB is the tested size) and 191 to 274 GB on an NVMe pool. Its own engine is downloaded into the Data folder on the first start. It is checked at 8k context and offers up to 1m.
First start: downloads the model into the Data folder and prepares it, which takes a while; watch the log. A stopped download resumes where it left off. Later starts go straight to serving.
API key: always on. Leave it empty and the first start makes one and keeps it in the Data folder; show it with: docker exec Strata strata launch --show-key --preset docker. Clients send it as Authorization: Bearer KEY.
Changing settings: edit them and Apply. The new values replace the saved ones on the next start; the model files and tuning stay in the Data folder.
Template and Unraid problems: the Support link. Strata itself: the Project link.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: llm qwen deepseek local ai openai anthropic api inference chat nvidia cuda gpu
Container.Requires: **Nvidia Driver plugin** on driver 580 or newer (575+ with the cuda12 tag). DeepSeek needs the cuda13 tag and an RTX 30 card or newer. Do not set a memory limit on the container: Strata plans from the server's whole RAM. Do not pin CPUs: the engine sets its own thread affinity.

Config.Name: WebUI / API port
Config.Description: Chat page, monitor and the API (/v1 for OpenAI clients, the root URL for Anthropic clients).

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: The model, the prepared pack, presets, tuning and the API key: tens of GB for Qwen, 191 to 274 GB for DeepSeek; the log names the size. Use a direct pool path on an NVMe drive (/mnt/cache/... or /mnt/POOLNAME/...), not /mnt/user: the engine reads the model files while it runs.

Config.Name: GPU
Config.Description: The cards the container sees: a UUID (GPU-xxxxxxxx-...) from the Nvidia Driver plugin page or nvidia-smi -L, several separated by commas, or all. With exactly two RTX 30 or two RTX 50 class cards, a supported Qwen3.8 file and a context up to 128k, Strata uses its all-cards split engine by itself.

Config.Name: Model
Config.Description: Empty: Strata picks the model it recommends for this server and says so in the log. Qwen3.8 (family qwen): Q2_0, IQ2_XS, IQ3_XXS or IQ3_S. Unsloth (unsloth): UD-IQ4_XS, UD-Q4_K_XL, UD-Q5_K_XL, UD-Q6_K_XL, Q8_0 and smaller UD-IQ1_M to UD-IQ3_XXS. Gyro (gyro): Gyro-S, Gyro-M. NVFP4 (nvfp4): NVFP4, NVFP4-NVIDIA, NVFP4-QAD. Qwen3.6-35B-A3B (qwen36): UD-Q4_K_XL, UD-Q6_K_XL, Q8_0. DeepSeek (deepseek41): ist-das-1.75bpw, ist-das-2.00bpw, ist-das-2.25bpw, ista-das-coder. See docs/MODELS.md in the Strata repository for what each needs.

Config.Name: Model family
Config.Description: Empty: Strata's recommendation, which may differ by hardware. Qwen3.8-Flash-Next: qwen (the original ISTA-DASLab packs), unsloth, gyro, coder, nvfp4 or swift (thinks shorter). qwen36: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B. deepseek41: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash (needs the cuda13 tag).

Config.Name: Context length
Config.Description: How much text it remembers at once. Longer costs memory. Qwen3.8 goes up to 256k. DeepSeek is checked at 8k and offers up to 1m, but nothing past 256k has been tested and a very long prompt is read slowly.

Config.Name: Vision
Config.Description: on: the model reads pictures (about 0.9 GB more to download). gpu or cpu choose where the picture reader runs. DeepSeek reads pictures with its own engine; off turns that off.

Config.Name: API key
Config.Description: 16 characters or more (openssl rand -hex 24 makes one). Empty: the first start makes one and keeps it in the Data folder.

Config.Name: Tuning
Config.Description: Measures the best engine settings for this server, once, on the next start, and keeps them. thorough takes longer than quick; how long depends on the hardware.

Config.Name: Tune again
Config.Description: 1 tunes again on the next start even if this preset is already tuned, for example after an update. Set it back to 0 afterwards.

Config.Name: Allow tuning to change answers
Config.Description: 1 lets the tuner also try settings that can change answers very slightly. 0 keeps only settings that leave answers the same.

Config.Name: Parallel requests
Config.Description: Requests answered at the same time, 1 to 8. Empty: fitted to the card. With 2 or more, Strata uses the MTP drafter, because its default DFlash2 drafter answers one request at a time. DeepSeek answers one at a time unless you set this.

Config.Name: KV cache type
Config.Description: Conversation memory format: int8 (default), q4_0 (half the memory), k8v4, fp16.

Config.Name: Existing model files
Config.Description: GGUF files you already have, as a path inside the container. Add a Path mapping for their folder (read-only is fine), e.g. /models, and enter that here; set Model too. Nothing is downloaded for the model itself.

Config.Name: Download despite old model files
Config.Description: When model files from the older image are still in /data/models, the start stops instead of downloading the model again (tens of GB) and the log says where they are. Use them with Existing model files, or set 1 to download anyway.

Config.Name: GPU roles
Config.Description: Several cards: a role for each, e.g. 1=main,0=helper (main, helper or off; cards you do not name are off). Empty: the engine's choice. See docs/MULTI_GPU.md in the Strata repository.

Config.Name: Engine settings
Config.Description: Advanced engine settings, space separated KEY=VALUE, like strata launch --set. For DeepSeek, dspark=on|off|auto sets its DSpark drafter (default auto). docs/SETTINGS.md in the Strata repository lists every setting.
